eraInfo.label: Romantic
eraInfo.story: Emotion, colour, and storytelling. Expect sweeping lines, rich harmony, and moments that feel like scenes from a novel.

composerInfo.name: Frédéric Chopin
composerInfo.hook: Chopin wrote the piano’s private poetry — rubato, colour, and singing lines.
composerInfo.bio: Mazurkas dance with a lifted beat; preludes are mood rooms; melodies should speak like a voice. Keep the left hand calm support while the right hand sings.

highlights: Chopin is closely tied to the piano — tone and touch are part of the story.

composerInfo.name: Frédéric Chopin
composerInfo.hook: Chopin wrote the piano’s private poetry — rubato, colour, and singing lines.

overview.title: Nocturne (easy)
overview.summary: Nocturne (easy) belongs to the Romantic era — music by Frédéric Chopin.

chapters.title: The story of the piece
chapters.body: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star is ready to explore on Lune. It is associated with Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. Stylistically it sits in the Classical world. Start by listening, then ask about the bars that surprise your hands. Place every phrase in the Classical sound-world: how would someone from that time shape it?

chapters.title: Era · Classical
chapters.body: Clarity, elegant proportions, and conversation between phrases. Themes are easy to follow — then they get playfully changed and returned.
tips: Save big drama for true climaxes.

chapters.title: About Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart
chapters.body: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756–1791) was a child prodigy who wrote with sparkling clarity. His piano music loves balanced phrases, graceful melodies, and witty surprises. Play Mozart with clean fingers, singing tone, and shapes that feel like questions and answers.
chapters.hook: Mozart makes elegance sound easy — every phrase is a clear conversation.
highlights: Mozart is closely tied to the piano — tone and touch are part of the story.
